column1: # eve-offline abyssal waves [A]: what each room of an abyssal run holds.
# AUTHORED, not extracted: the client ships no spawn rows for the abyssal rooms,
# so this table is invented. Falsified by client data that has them, or by pilots
# finding a tier too easy or too hard. type_ids are abyssal NPC types (groups
# 1982 and 1997 of the type data, the client's AbyssTargets). The filament's
# weather does not change the waves.
# tier = the played tier (0 to 6); room, wave = 1-based; the next wave comes
# when the last one is dead, the gate when the last wave is.
